    - after rendering every page's defer block Complete, all id attributes in the fixture are unique

  <action>
`SectionNav` (selector `cd-section-nav`, OnPush):
- Export `NavEntry { id: string; label: string; kind: 'page' | 'section'; pageId: string }`.
- Input `entries = input.required<readonly NavEntry[]>()`; private `current = signal<string | null>(null)`.
- Template: `<nav class="section-nav" aria-label="Sections">`, then `@for (e of entries(); track e.id)` renders `<a [attr.href]="'#' + e.id" [class.section]="e.kind === 'section'" [attr.aria-current]="current() === e.id ? 'true' : null" (click)="go($event, e)">{{ e.label }}</a>`.
- Scroll-spy uses `afterRenderEffect`, re-run when `entries()` changes, because deferred editors add section anchors after first render:
  - Disconnect the previous observer and create `new IntersectionObserver(callback, { rootMargin: '-64px 0px -55% 0px' })`. The 64 px is `--nav-height` 52 + 12; read it via `getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--nav-height')` with 52 as fallback.
  - Observe every entry's element that exists.
  - The callback keeps a Map of id to `{ intersecting, top }` from `boundingClientRect.top`, then sets current to the intersecting id with the smallest top. When none intersect, current keeps its previous value.
  - Disconnect on destroy.
- `go(event, entry)`: `preventDefault()`; target is `document.getElementById(entry.id) ?? document.getElementById(entry.pageId)`; call `scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' })` with no smooth behaviour; set current.
- When current changes, keep the current pill visible inside the horizontally scrolling nav with `link.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' })`.
- SCSS (port prototype lines 196-217, tokens only):
  - `.section-nav`: `position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 5`, `--bg` background, hairline bottom border, `min-height: var(--nav-height)`, flex row with `overflow-x: auto`, gap `--space-2`, no wrap.
  - Links: mono 11.5px uppercase, `--radius-full`, transparent 1px border, 44 px min-height, `--text-muted`; hover gives accent text and `--border-strong` border; `[aria-current='true']` gives accent text and accent border.
  - `.section`: 10px, `--text-muted`, padding-inline `--space-2`, with `::before { content: '·' / ''; }` so the dot is not announced.
  - `@media print { .section-nav { display: none; } }`.
  - Under 4 kB.

[]).map(s => ({ id: s.id, label: s.label, kind: 'section', pageId }))`.
- Render `@if (store.pages().length > 0) { <cd-section-nav [entries]="navEntries()" /> }` directly after the header card (D-04).

- Extend `character-page.component.spec.ts` for the page-level bullets, using `provideTestPlugins()` where two pages are needed.
